rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a material template: both communications address the Secretary of Defense, transmit an attached third-party document, characterize its recommendations as meritorious, and ask the Secretary to consider and pursue responsive action. C07 has a similar attachment-assessment-action sequence but a different recipient and purpose. C06 shares the phrasing about a received letter and “It seems to me,” but lacks the child’s attachment-driven administrative request.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Attached is copy of a letter from Senator Russell, which I think has a lot of merit.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Attached is a copy of my Message to Congress... along with the report... These recommendations appear to have merit
shared_material.explanation: Both introduce attached material to the Secretary of Defense and explicitly endorse its merit.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It seems to me that it would be well to ask Sweden, Switzerland, India, Pakistan and Indonesia to send military men to Korea
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope you will consider them carefully, and determine what steps may be appropriate to carry them out.
shared_material.explanation: Both convert the endorsed attachment into a request that the Secretary of Defense consider or undertake concrete action.
